oneOf.description: Canonical list form. Each entry has a name and optional values.
Map shorthand: key is annotation name; value is null (name-only), a single string, or an array of strings.

region.description: AWS region hosting the Athena service and Glue Data Catalog.

workgroup.description:
Athena workgroup. Defaults to "primary" when empty. Must have a
ResultConfiguration.OutputLocation configured.

catalog.description: Glue Data Catalog name. Defaults to "AwsDataCatalog" when empty.

access_key_id.description: Static AWS credentials. Pair access_key_id with secret_access_key.

session_token.description:
Optional STS session token, when access_key_id+secret_access_key are
short-lived STS credentials.

aws_profile.description:
Named AWS shared-config profile (from ~/.aws/credentials or
~/.aws/config). Used only when static credentials are absent.

role_arn.description:
IAM role ARN to assume via STS. Wraps whichever base credentials
resolved above (or the host's default chain when no other auth is set).

external_id.description: External ID required by the role's trust policy. Pair with role_arn.

role_session_name.description: Optional STS session name. Defaults to "synq-athena".

scope.description:
Scope filter for include/exclude filtering by Glue catalog, Glue
database, and table. Mapping: ScopeRule.database = Glue catalog,
ScopeRule.schema = Glue database, ScopeRule.table = Glue table/view.

use_show_create_table.description:
Use SHOW CREATE TABLE to retrieve full table DDL (CTAS bodies, Iceberg
TBLPROPERTIES, Hive external LOCATION/SerDe). One Athena query per
table — billed at the 10MB scan minimum each.

use_show_create_view.description:
Use SHOW CREATE VIEW to retrieve full view DDL instead of the
rewritten body from information_schema.views.view_definition.

use_iceberg_metrics_scan.description:
For Iceberg tables, fan out one Athena query per table to read row
count, total file size, snapshot commit timestamp, and partition
columns from the table's $files / $snapshots / $partitions metadata
tables. Hive externals are unaffected.

AthenaConf.description: AthenaConf contains Amazon Athena connection parameters.

service_account_key.description: Inline JSON content of the service account key.

service_account_key_file.description: Path to the service account key JSON file.

datasets.description:
Explicit list of dataset names to scrape. When set, only these datasets are queried
and project-level bigquery.datasets.list permission is not required.

factor.description: Number of segments per bisection level.

threshold.description: Stop drilling when segment row count falls below this.

time_column.description: Column for time-based partitioning (required when strategy is 'time').

BisectionConfig.description: BisectionConfig controls the bisection drill-down behavior.

database.description: Database to connect to. If empty, all databases are scraped.

oneOf.description: Map source column names to target column names (object format)
Map source column names to target column names (array format)

name.description: Display name for this connection. Defaults to the connection ID (map key).

disabled.description: When true, the connection is skipped during execution.

parallelism.description: Maximum number of parallel queries. Range: 1-256. Defaults to 8.

Connection.description: Connection is a single database connection entry in a connections map.

CutoffApply.description: CutoffApply configures custom WHERE clause generation for cutoff.

column.description: Column to filter on. When not set, uses the derivation column.

CutoffApplySide.description: CutoffApplySide configures WHERE clause generation for one side.

column.description: Simple: same column for both source and target watermark derivation.

source.description: Advanced: full per-side watermark derivation config.

target.description: Advanced: full per-side watermark derivation config.

combine.description: How to combine watermarks when both sides are configured: min, max, source, target.

truncate.description: Truncate the combined watermark to a time boundary before applying.

offset.description: Time offset applied after truncation. Negative durations create a safety buffer (e.g., '-30m').

apply.description: Advanced: custom apply config for WHERE clause generation.

CutoffConfig.description: CutoffConfig defines a dynamic cutoff filter for sync reconciliation.

column.description:
Column to derive the watermark from (e.g., "created_at", "synced_at").
Required when query is not set.

aggregate.description: Aggregate function for watermark derivation: MAX (default) or MIN.

query.description:
Custom SQL query for watermark derivation. Must return a single row with a "watermark" column.
When not set, auto-generated from the dataset at runtime.

CutoffSideConfig.description: CutoffSideConfig configures watermark derivation for one side (source or target).

warehouse.description: SQL warehouse ID to use for queries.

connection.description: Connection name (must exist in connections map).

query.description: Base SQL query (mutually exclusive with 'table'). Supports {{variable_name}} interpolation.

table.description: Table reference (mutually exclusive with 'query'). Accepts "db.schema.table" string or structured object.

columns.description: Explicit column list (only with 'table'). Mutually exclusive with 'exclude_columns'.

exclude_columns.description: Columns to exclude (only with 'table', resolved at runtime). Mutually exclusive with 'columns'.

where.description: SQL WHERE clause filter (only with 'table'). Applied as WHERE (condition). Supports {{variable_name}} interpolation.

as_of.description: Time-travel timestamp. Wraps query with database-specific time-travel syntax.

Dataset.description: Dataset defines a data source for reconciliation.

database.description: File path, ':memory:' for in-memory, or MotherDuck database name.

motherduck_token.description: MotherDuck authentication token (required for cloud MotherDuck).

DuckDBConf.description: DuckDBConf contains DuckDB / MotherDuck connection parameters.

query_timeout.description: Per-query timeout as a Go duration string (e.g., '30s', '5m').

max_retries.description: Maximum retry attempts for transient query failures.

retry_initial_delay.description: Initial backoff delay before the first retry.

retry_backoff_factor.description: Backoff multiplier applied after each retry.

ErrorHandlingConfig.description: ErrorHandlingConfig controls retry behavior for query failures.

host.description:
Hostname of the workspace's SQL analytics endpoint. Copy it from the
Fabric portal: open your Warehouse or Lakehouse, then Settings → SQL
connection string.

database.description:
Default database for queries that don't name one explicitly. Optional —
defaults to "master". Because metadata and metric queries are always
fully qualified, this only affects ad-hoc SQL that omits the database.

auth_type.description:
How to authenticate to Fabric. Optional — defaults to a service principal
(client_id + client_secret). Values are matched case-insensitively, and
the equivalent dbt-fabric and Microsoft ODBC spellings are also accepted:
  - "service_principal" (default): Entra ID service principal. Set
    client_id, client_secret and, if needed, tenant_id.
  - "azure_cli": reuse the machine's `az login` session. On-prem agent only.
  - "default": try Azure's default credential chain (environment, managed
    identity, CLI, ...). On-prem agent only.
  - "managed_identity": use an Azure managed identity; set client_id to
    select a user-assigned identity. On-prem agent only.

client_id.description:
Application (client) ID of the Entra ID service principal. When auth_type
is "managed_identity", this instead selects a user-assigned identity.

client_secret.description:
Client secret for the service principal. Supply it through an environment
variable (e.g. ${FABRIC_CLIENT_SECRET}) rather than committing it in plain
text.

tenant_id.description:
Entra ID tenant (directory) ID. Optional — inferred from the endpoint
hostname when omitted. Set it only when the service principal lives in a
different tenant than the workspace.

access_token.description:
A pre-acquired Entra ID OAuth access token for the SQL scope
(https://database.windows.net/.default). Optional — when set it overrides
every other authentication method. Mainly for hosted deployments that mint
their own token.

scope.description:
Optional include/exclude filter that limits which databases, schemas and
tables are scanned. When omitted, the whole workspace is scanned.

FabricConf.description: FabricConf contains the connection settings for a Microsoft Fabric Warehouse or Lakehouse SQL analytics endpoint.

trust_cert.description: Trust the server certificate without validation.

access_token.description: Pre-acquired access token for Azure AD authentication.

application_client_id.description: Azure AD application client ID for service principal auth.

MSSQLConf.description: MSSQLConf contains Microsoft SQL Server / Azure SQL Database connection parameters.

MeasureConfig.description: MeasureConfig defines a column + aggregation function pair.

params.description: Additional DSN parameters passed to the driver.

wallet_path.description: Path to Oracle Wallet directory for authentication.

use_diagnostics_pack.description: Enable Oracle Diagnostics Pack features (AWR, ASH).

OracleConf.description: OracleConf contains Oracle Database connection parameters.

key_column.description:
Single key column for bisection split points and aggregate grouping.
Deprecated in favor of key_columns; accepts a string or a one-element list.
Set either key_column or key_columns, not both.

key_columns.description:
Ordered key columns for bisection split points and aggregate grouping.
Supports composite (multi-column) keys; the bisection orders and
range-filters on the column tuple. Accepts a string or a list of strings.

column_mapping.description: Column name mapping between source and target.

cutoff.description: Dynamic cutoff filter. Derives a watermark value from actual data to exclude rows not yet synced.

annotations.description: Annotations attached to this reconciliation case. Merged with suite-level annotations.

teardown_on_failure.description: Whether teardown runs on failure. Inherits from suite level when not set.

ignore_setup_errors.description: When true, logs setup errors as warnings. Inherits from suite level when not set.

Reconciliation.description: Reconciliation defines a single reconciliation scenario.

freshness_from_query_logs.description: Estimate table freshness from Redshift query logs instead of metadata.

RedshiftConf.description: RedshiftConf contains Amazon Redshift connection parameters.

ReportingConfig.description: ReportingConfig controls what level of detail is reported.

client_id.description: OAuth client ID for authenticating with Coalesce Quality.

client_secret.description: OAuth client secret for authenticating with Coalesce Quality.

endpoint.description: gRPC endpoint for the Coalesce Quality API (e.g. "developer.synq.io:443").

ingest_endpoint.description: gRPC endpoint for the Coalesce Quality ingest API. Defaults to Endpoint if empty.

oauth_url.description: OAuth token URL. Derived from Endpoint if empty.

SYNQConfig.description: SYNQConfig holds Coalesce Quality connection settings.

include.description: Include rules. If non-empty, only matching objects are accepted.

exclude.description: Exclude rules. Matching objects are rejected, even if they match an include rule.

ScopeConf.description: ScopeConf is the YAML representation of synq.common.v1.ScopeFilter — the shared include/exclude filter used by warehouses with hierarchical catalogs.

database.description: Database-level pattern (catalog for Athena/Trino/Databricks, project for BigQuery).

schema.description: Schema-level pattern (Glue database for Athena, dataset for BigQuery).

ScopeRuleConf.description: ScopeRuleConf is a single include/exclude rule.

warehouse.description: Virtual warehouse to use for queries.

private_key.description: PEM-encoded private key content for key-pair authentication.

private_key_file.description: Path to a PEM-encoded private key file.

private_key_passphrase.description: Passphrase to decrypt the private key.

databases.description: Databases to include. If empty, all accessible databases are scraped.

use_get_ddl.description: Use GET_DDL() to retrieve DDL for tables and views.

account_usage_db.description: Database containing the ACCOUNT_USAGE schema. Defaults to SNOWFLAKE.

auth_type.description: Set to "externalbrowser" to use SSO browser-based authentication.

percentage_mode.description: Percentage formula: source, target, or symmetric.

per_measure.description: Per measure threshold overrides, keyed by FUNC(column).

ThresholdConfig.description: ThresholdConfig defines tolerance for aggregate differences.

use_plaintext.description: Use a plain HTTP connection instead of HTTPS.

catalogs.description: Catalogs to include. Required for most Trino deployments.

TrinoConf.description: TrinoConf contains Trino / Starburst connection parameters.

lookback.description: How far back to look from the current time (e.g., '14d', '2h').

name.description: Short machine identifier for the suite.

variables.description: Template variables for query interpolation via {{variable_name}} syntax.

setup.description: Setup queries run once before all reconciliations begin.

teardown.description: Teardown queries run once after all reconciliations complete.

setup_file.description: SQL file(s) to load and run as setup queries.

teardown_file.description: SQL file(s) to load and run as teardown queries.

teardown_on_failure.description: Whether teardown runs even when reconciliations fail with infrastructure errors.

ignore_setup_errors.description: When true, logs setup query errors as warnings and continues instead of aborting.

strict_time_references.description: When true, time reference detection (NOW(), CURRENT_DATE, etc.) returns an error instead of a warning.

synq.description: Coalesce Quality API credentials for sending audit logs.

title: Coalesce Quality Recon Configuration
description: Configuration file format for synq-recon, the Coalesce Quality data reconciliation tool that compares datasets across databases.
